SINDH UNIVERSITIES LAWS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
SINDH UNIVERSITIES LAWS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
An Act further to amend Sindh
Universities Laws
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part IV, 15th September, 1997]
No.PAS/Legis‑B‑12/97,
dated 15‑9‑1997.‑‑The Sindh Universities Laws
(Amendment) Bill, 1997 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 24th May, 1997 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 9th July, 1997 is
hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
l. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Act may be called the Sindh
Universities Laws (Amendment) Act, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once

Amendment of Sindh Acts XXIV and XXV of 1972, III, IV and V of 1977 and XI of 1986

SINDH UNIVERSITIES LAWS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
SINDH UNIVERSITIES LAWS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
An Act further to amend Sindh
Universities Laws
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part IV, 15th September, 1997]
No.PAS/Legis‑B‑12/97,
dated 15‑9‑1997.‑‑The Sindh Universities Laws
(Amendment) Bill, 1997 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 24th May, 1997 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 9th July, 1997 is
hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of Sindh Acts
XXIV and XXV of 1972, III, IV and V of 1977 and XI of 1986.‑(a) In
the University of Sindh Act, 1972 and the University of Karachi Act, 1972, in
section 40‑A.
(b) In the N.E.D. 'University of
Engineering and Technology Act, 1977, the Mehran University of Engineering and
Technology Act, 1977, and the Sindh Agricultural University Act, 1977, in
section 37.
(c) In the Shah Abdul Latif
University Act, 1986, in section 43, in clause (i), after the semi‑colon
the following proviso shall be inserted:‑‑
"Provided
that no employee shall be retired unless he of she has been informed in writing
of the grounds of the action proposed to be taken against him and has been
given reasonable opportunity of showing cause against that action; "
